concept: FSx for Windows File Server: SMB/NTFS with Active Directory integration
tests: Choosing a managed file system for a Windows app with SMB, NTFS and AD.
expected: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server: Windows-native, SMB, NTFS, Active Directory integration. Triggers: "Windows-based", "SMB", "NTFS", "Active Directory integration".
why_not: EFS is NFS for Linux; S3 is object storage with no SMB; FSx for Lustre is HPC, not Windows file shares.
